recognition: No specific recognition of the target study. B1-S1_S4 is assessed only from the supplied returned abstract and metadata.
summary: The returned evidence changes H1 from wholly ungrounded to an analogy-motivated but still unverified hypothesis. B1-S1_S4 (2021-02-08; abstract only) reports composition-dependent multiphasic morphology in a ternary PLP/RRP/RNA system: competition for RRP yields homotypic PLP and heterotypic RRP-RNA phases, and RNA:RRP stoichiometry and interaction hierarchy determine engulfment morphology. This establishes that composition and interaction hierarchy can govern spatial organization in that protein-RNA system; it does not establish RNA-RNA demixing, an RNA-poor cavity, or the kinetic bridge in the present droplets. B1-S1_S3 (2023-03-07; abstract-only review) gives broad associative/segregative transition context without the needed conditions. The case still shows only a condition-level rise in B empty-area fraction from 0.01381 at 0 h to 0.08918 at 24 h versus A falling from 0.01487 to 0.00446; fields/objects are not independent preparation replicates, and the statistic definition is conflicted. E02 endpoints and E04 bulk coexistence data do not demonstrate within-droplet composition or explain the time trend. The regular-solution spinodal remains a conditional model consequence, not an estimate or evidence of the mechanism.

candidates.target: Explain whether the rising B empty-area statistic reflects formation of internal RNA-poor domains, and identify a composition-dependent mechanism that could produce them.
known_relations: B reported field statistic increases 0-24 h and A decreases (initial_measurements.json); treatment does not identify cause.
Gel-purified template-length fractions have different endpoint empty-area summaries (E02 / fraction_dev.json); one preparation, no precise mixture, RNA yield, or time course.

E04 reports bulk reference and variant concentrations in dilute/dense phases for three tie-lines. Tie-line 0 has zero variant at both ends, so its partition ratio is undefined. These endpoints provide no spatial cavity composition or time-resolved B RNA mixture.
DNA read frequencies do not establish transcript abundance or RNA composition.
The reported f measurement mapping has an unresolved conflict between the case brief's area-ratio definition and prior notes' per-droplet arithmetic-mean description.

B1-S1_S4 (abstract, 2021-02-08) reports that in a ternary PLP/RRP/RNA system competition for a shared partner produces RNA-induced demixing into homotypic PLP-rich and heterotypic RRP-RNA phases; RNA:RRP stoichiometry and interaction hierarchy determine non-, partial-, or complete-engulfing morphologies. This supports composition-sensitive spatial organization in a protein-RNA system, not demixing between two RNA species or formation of RNA-poor cavities in the present transcription droplets.

hypotheses.status: retained as an explicitly new, unverified transfer hypothesis; returned abstract evidence motivates composition-sensitive morphology by analogy but does not establish the RNA-RNA or cavity bridge
hypotheses.statement: If reference-like and variant/length-class RNAs mix unfavorably in the dense phase, a composition fluctuation can cross a demixing instability; a locally RNA-poor internal domain then appears as a cavity. Continued production or redistribution could increase its incidence, but this kinetic bridge is not established.
hypotheses.derived_consequence: For the dimensionless binary mixing free energy g(phi)=phi ln(phi)+(1-phi)ln(1-phi)+chi phi(1-phi), g''(phi)=1/phi+1/(1-phi)-2chi. The homogeneous composition is locally unstable only when chi>1/[2 phi(1-phi)]; at phi=0.5 this is chi>2. No supplied measurement estimates phi or chi.
hypotheses.untested_bridge: The returned study is a ternary protein/protein/RNA system. Transfer to two RNA classes in a protein-free or differently composed transcribing droplet is unsupported. Its coexisting phases and engulfment morphologies are not evidence that the dark regions here are cavities, are RNA-poor, or arise by the same mechanism.

gaps.description: Still missing evidence that reference-like and variant/length-class RNAs themselves demix within the relevant dense phase, and that such a domain maps to an internal RNA-poor cavity. B1-S1_S4 supports composition-dependent spatial organization only in a PLP/RRP/RNA ternary system; B1-S1_S3 gives broad associative-biomacromolecule background. Neither abstract establishes the needed RNA-RNA relation or case-specific conditions.
Resolve whether f is a pooled area ratio or an arithmetic mean of per-droplet fractions; the two statistics have different weighting and can respond differently to population changes.

variables_units.chi: dimensionless effective unlike-species interaction parameter in the stated mean-field free energy; unmeasured
variables_units.g: dimensionless free energy per kBT under the stated model assumption
variables_units.f: reported image-derived empty-area fraction; dimensionless, measurement weighting unresolved
variables_units.C_ref: reference RNA concentration, ng/uL, available only for bulk E04 endpoints
variables_units.C_var: variant RNA concentration, ng/uL, available only for bulk E04 endpoints

equations: g(phi)=phi ln(phi)+(1-phi)ln(1-phi)+chi phi(1-phi), 0<phi<1; assumed regular-solution model, not fitted.
g''(phi)=1/phi+1/(1-phi)-2chi; local spinodal condition g''<0, equivalently chi>1/[2 phi(1-phi)].
No equation currently maps the local composition field or domain geometry to the image statistic f(t); that mapping remains an explicit missing relation.

parameters_ranges.chi: No empirical range available; conditional instability threshold is 1/[2 phi(1-phi)] for 0<phi<1.
parameters_ranges.phi: 0<phi<1 by definition; relevant local and mean values unknown.

candidates.initial_boundary_conditions: No spatial initial condition, boundary condition, or reaction/transport rate is supplied. The instability calculation assumes a locally homogeneous binary mixture before a small composition perturbation; it makes no kinetic prediction.
candidates.observation_mapping: A local RNA-poor domain would count as a cavity only if it yields a dark segmented region under the imaging/threshold protocol. E04 bulk concentrations and f cannot be equated; no local composition imaging, cavity volume, or calibrated intensity-to-concentration mapping is supplied. Resolve the f aggregation definition before using a population model.
alternatives: Population composition or track/segmentation selection changes the field statistic while individual droplets need not acquire a new internal phase; prior tracking summary contains motion, not same-droplet cavity trajectories.
Amplification-associated carryover or another unmeasured reaction condition changes transcription or morphology without sequence-mixture-driven demixing; no matched carryover control is supplied.

A single dense phase with non-equilibrium production/transport gradients could yield dark regions without equilibrium composition demixing; no relevant spatial production or transport measurements are supplied.
predictions: Conditional H1 prediction, sharpened by the analogy: if RNA composition-selective interactions drive cavities, cavity interior and adjacent dense material should show a reproducible within-droplet reference:variant or length-class ratio contrast; changing the RNA-class mixture at matched total RNA and reaction conditions should alter cavity occurrence or morphology. The returned literature does not establish that such a contrast or response occurs here.
Population/measurement alternative: no required within-droplet species-ratio contrast; changes in droplet inclusion, weights, or segmentation can alter f.
Bulk E04 tie-line concentrations alone cannot discriminate these predictions.
checks: Spinodal derivation is dimensionless and applies only to the explicitly assumed binary regular-solution free energy.
At phi=0.5, threshold chi>2; as phi approaches 0 or 1, the threshold diverges, consistent with the stated model's lack of instability at a pure-component boundary for finite chi.
No numerical fit, simulation, or estimate of chi/phi was performed.
Do not infer RNA abundance from DNA read fractions or equate image area fraction with concentration, volume fraction, or free energy.

B1-S1_S4 is abstract-only evidence: its stated result is for competition between PLP and RNA for shared RRP, with stoichiometry/hierarchy affecting multiphasic morphology; no numerical thresholds, RNA-RNA interaction parameter, or internal-cavity mechanism can be extracted.
B1-S1_S3 abstract provides general phase-transition framing for associative proteins/nucleic acids but does not specify internal RNA-RNA demixing conditions.
No returned source resolves the observation-statistic definition conflict or converts bulk tie-line values into local cavity composition.
evidence_conflicts: case_brief.md defines the supplied quantity as segmented dark area divided by total filled droplet area; prior leader_04 says it is the arithmetic mean of per-droplet fractions and explicitly distinguishes that from an area-weighted ratio. Maintain both definitions as a conflict pending source-level clarification.

Listed non-reference DNA read fractions total 5.00%, while a prior researcher_01 reply said 4.66%; leader_03 records the arithmetic correction. Use 5.00% for the listed reads, with total reference plus listed reads 99.66% and remaining 0.34% unaccounted/rounding.

Whether internal cavities are compositionally distinct phases or arise from gradients, population selection, or image processing.
